name: The Mother
description: Lost in a world soon to take you with it. Your journey will be one of<LINE>choices and consequences. Keep your closest treasures with you before you soon depart.

mother/core._doc_economy: POINT ECONOMY (M-exh2) -- stamina is 0..stamina_max points (pip = stamina_max / hud_pip_count). All *_per_second rates are points per SECOND (applied per-frame as rate/40); 0 disables that source.
mother/core._doc_discrete: DISCRETE COSTS (points, charged once per action) -- slide on the animation edge; jumps by type (pole & wall jumps use pole_wall_jump_cost; a jump within chain_jump_window frames of the last is 'chained' and costs x(1 + count*chain_jump_multiplier)); spear/rock throws by held type (other throws are free); boost_swim on each underwater dash.
mother/core._doc_continuous: CONTINUOUS DRAINS (points/second) -- roll while the roll animation runs (replaces the old one-shot roll cost); walk on ground under input; swim (submerged, or paddling at the surface) vs float (idle at the surface); pole hold/climb on beams; vine hold/climb on vines & rot lines; carry while moving with a held creature (light/heavy split is the game's own; cicadas free), slugpup in hand or on back adds slugpup_carry on top.
mother/core._doc_gains: GAINS -- eating credits eat_gain_per_pip stamina for every FOOD PIP the item gives (a quarter-pip item credits a quarter of it; ignores delay + zone throttle). Rotted blue fruit credits 0 (detected directly); anything the game reports as zero-nourishment also credits 0. Passive rest = HIGHEST single rate that applies, only while holding still: stand (grounded; in zero-G it applies while fully still without ground), lay (crouched/crawling + grounded), iterator (within iterator_rest_radius px of an Oracle; iterator_rest_oracles lists qualifying IDs like SS/SL, empty = all). Passive gains wait recharge_delay frames after any action and are multiplied by exhausted_recharge_mult inside the red zone.
mother/core._doc_zone: OVEREXERTION RED ZONE -- enter at/below overexert_enter points, leave at/above overexert_exit (hysteresis, no flicker). SLOWDOWN SCALES WITH DEPTH: the speed multiplier is overexert_speed_mult right at the entry line and slides down to overexert_speed_mult_min at 0 points. It always applies to running; overexert_slow_climb / _swim / _throw extend it to pole+corridor climbing, swimming, and throw strength (spears and rocks fly slower and shorter). Passive gains are throttled inside the zone.
mother/core._doc_hit: TAKING DAMAGE -- hit_stamina_cost points are lost each time she is hit (bites, rocks, spears, explosions; falls are free). 0 = off (the designer's first answer); 25 was the offered 'mean' option. One charge per hit_cost_cooldown frames so an explosion doesn't charge every frame.
mother/core._doc_feel: FEEL TIERS -- in the red zone (before the stun): a quiet heartbeat loop (feel_heartbeat_zone_sound at feel_heartbeat_vol_zone) plus slight breathing (feel_breath_sound at feel_breath_vol_zone), no vignette. While she is DOWN (Forced Stun or legacy collapse): the vignette, the louder heartbeat (feel_heartbeat_stun_sound at feel_heartbeat_vol_stun), louder breathing (feel_breath_vol_stun) and the stamina pips throb by hud_pulse_scale on the same heartbeat. Sound values are game SoundIDs: the heartbeat defaults are the Watcher DLC loops (HeartbeatMed_LOOP / HeartbeatFast_LOOP / HeartbeatHard_LOOP); Mother_Breath_LOOP is the mod's placeholder clip at soundeffects/Mother_Breath_LOOP.wav -- replace that file to change the breathing. 'None' silences a slot.
mother/core._doc_empty: AT ZERO -- exhaustion_empty_mode 'stun' (default): a Forced Stun for exhaustion_stun_seconds (helpless, spasming, full vignette/shake; stun_feed_per_frame is the per-frame stun feed), then stamina refills to post_stun_refill; lizard bites during the stun have their kill chance multiplied by stun_bite_death_mult. Mode 'collapse': the legacy survive-or-die loop below. EARLY BIRTH -- each time she hits zero in one cycle counts; at early_birth_limit she dies and the death-persistent save flag motherEarlyBirth is set. ZERO-G -- below zero_g_threshold gravity, continuous drains and the empty-state trigger are off (throw costs and gains still apply).
mother/core._doc_collapse: LEGACY COLLAPSE (exhaustion_empty_mode = 'collapse'; values now in POINTS) -- survival_time(frames) counts down; recovery_rate refills each frame while holding still (ignores recharge_delay); moving instead drains move_drain_rate points/frame; reach exit points to stand up and live; acting while empty removes act_penalty frames (or act_fatal=true kills instantly); move_penalty damps her velocity each frame (<1 = sluggish, still able to act).
mother/core._doc_effects: DANGEROUS-EXHAUSTION EFFECTS -- intensity 0..1 rises as survival_time runs out AND as stamina stays below exit (always 1 during a Forced Stun). vignette (RRGGBB tint) darkens to vignette_max_alpha; it pulses like a heartbeat, beat period going heartbeat_slow->heartbeat_fast frames; camera shakes up to shake_max.
mother/core._doc_hud: HUD METER -- reveals while stamina < hud_show_below POINTS (stays hud_reveal_frames after); y_offset negative = below food pips; fill color RRGGBB for available stamina, zone color for the red-zone pips (outlined normally, solid red while she's down); pip_count applies on next cycle, the rest are live.
mother/core._doc_observability: OBSERVABILITY -- debug=true turns on grep-able [Mother][tag] logging (exh2 events use [Mother][Exh2]). INTENSITY -- how time-danger vs stamina-danger blend while collapsed. PULSE -- vignette heartbeat throb: pulse = pulse_base + pulse_depth*(0.5+0.5*sin); defaults reproduce the original 0.65+0.35*sin, range 0.30..1.00.
mother/core._doc_pulseshape: PULSE SHAPE -- pulse_shape 'punch' (default) SHOOTS the vignette in on each beat and lets it decay: pulse_attack is the fraction of ONE beat spent snapping in (0.04 at 18 f/beat is under a single tick, i.e. instant), pulse_decay is how fast it falls away after the hit (bigger = snappier), pulse_sustain is the floor it holds between beats (0 = decays all the way back to pulse_base). Set pulse_shape to 'sine' to restore the old smooth symmetric throb. The HUD pip row uses the same envelope, so pips and vignette punch together. TUNING BY EAR: too soft -> raise pulse_depth or lower pulse_sustain; not jumpy enough -> lower pulse_attack and raise pulse_decay; too stroby -> raise pulse_sustain.
mother/core._doc_heartsync: HEARTBEAT AUDIO LOCK -- heartbeat_sync_audio makes the LOOPING CLIP the master clock: the vignette throb (and the pip pulse) read the emitter's real playhead, so they cannot drift from the audible thump and the sound is never pitch-shifted. heartbeat_slow/_fast then only apply as the fallback (sync off, sound None, clip still streaming in, or legacy 'collapse' mode). heartbeat_beats_per_loop = how many thumps are inside ONE loop of the clip -- set it from the clipLen the log prints on the first beat ([Mother][Exh2] heartbeat clip ... clipLen=). MEASURED 2026-09-09: HeartbeatHard_LOOP (the DOWN clip, the only one with a vignette) is 5.343s and holds 9 ba-dums -> 0.594s/beat, 101 BPM; at the old value of 1 the punch spanned the whole loop and fired once every 9 thumps. HeartbeatMed_LOOP (zone) is 7.172s and has no visual on it, so this one key currently only needs to be right for the DOWN clip. heartbeat_phase_offset slides the visual against the audio; with pulse_shape 'punch' the hit lands at the START of the beat, so 0 is correct when the thump sits at the very start of the clip (the old 'sine' shape wanted 0.25 instead). All three hot-reload, so tune the offset by ear while she is down.
